question: What twofold consequence follows for one who neglects his proper duties?
premises: Neglect of duty brings social condemnation.
Such neglect also has consequences beyond this life.
The afterlife consequence is suffering in hell.
inference: Such a person is censured in this world and becomes a dweller in hell in the next.
plain_english: In this world he is censured by people, and in the next world he becomes a dweller in hell.
